name: Software release checklist
summary: A repeatable path from code freeze to post-release, with a rollback plan.
audience: Teams shipping software on a schedule

lists.name: Prep
lists.description: Everything before the release: freeze, changelog, migrations and communication.

lists.name: Verify
lists.description: Prove it works on a release candidate: tests, smoke checks and sign-offs.

lists.name: Ship
lists.description: The release itself. Do not start if the rollback plan is unclear.

lists.name: Post-release
lists.description: Watch the dashboards, tell people and capture what to improve.

cards.name: Release 1.0
cards.description: Due a week from now: adjust the date when you know the real one.

cards.name: Smoke test the release candidate
cards.description: Run the critical paths on a production-like environment.

cards.name: Announce and monitor
cards.description: Post the notes, update the docs and watch errors for the first day.
